Research Leadership · PredictWatch

Ogólnopolskie Badanie Nałogów 2022

National Research Study · 2022

Full Coordination: R&D → App Design → Marketing → Media

Supervised Poland's largest addiction behaviour study — coordinating across scientific experts (Polish Academy of Sciences, dr hab. Mateusz Gola UC San Diego / IP PAN, dr Maria Banaszak MONAR), the R&D team, product and design teams, and the marketing department. Led the complete pipeline: from research methodology and Nałogometr app design through campaign execution and national press outreach. The study covered 17 addiction categories including alcohol, nicotine, cannabis, pornography, gaming, gambling, social media, compulsive eating, stimulants, and opioids.

20,826 participants 109-page report Polish Academy of Sciences MONAR Nałogometr app National media coverage

Study Scope & Results

20,826 people registered to participate in the OBN 2022 study using the Nałogometr app. Participants came not only from Poland (18,557) but also from other countries — primarily Poles living abroad in the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands. Approximately 30% used iOS devices, with Android accounting for ~70%. The study generated significant national media coverage and positioned PredictWatch as a credible scientific authority in behavioural health.
